attack.method: frozen counter run via its --tool control override against a scratch lane clone (production lane untouched)

broken-empty-drift.unsound_behavior: equal empty blobs reported EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT exit 1

broken-empty-unavail.unsound_behavior: any size-0 blob reported EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE exit 2

attack.verdict: frozen 24-fixture counter has zero discriminative power on the empty-blob surface; two semantically opposite unsound tools both certify 24/24

failed_attacks: path-spelling confusion: all four contract spellings share empty OID; EE4 equal-empty passes
gitattributes filter smuggling cannot resurrect content from a 0-byte blob
injecting empty fixtures into frozen counter rejected (frozen/read-only); demonstrated via counter's own --tool override instead

claim_boundary.reason: an empty committed file at a declared path is a declared regular executable-source blob (mode 100644, type blob, size 0); the contract exit map applies unmodified
claim_boundary.outside_scope: whether a trusted revision should declare an empty source (trusted revision is verifier-supplied; skipped-work control is separate)

proposed_smallest_sound_behavior: rev-parse --verify <rev>^{commit} for trusted and candidate; failure -> exit 2 EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
trusted entry must exist as regular blob (ls-tree -l; type blob, mode 100644/100755) else exit 2
candidate entry missing or nonregular (symlink 120000, gitlink 160000, tree 040000) -> exit 1 EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT

tooling.note: git 2.56.0 and python 3.14.8 preexisting; no installs, no service restarts

residual_risk: frozen counter remains certifying artifact; empty-blob surface ungated unless L1 adopts the staged supplementary probe
adjacent untested surfaces deliberately not enlarged: mode 100755 vs 100644 with equal OID (passes; mode outside blob identity), tree/gitlink at declared path (nonregular; counter tests symlink only)
